title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on virtues of dharma, knowledge and non-violence
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on the virtues of dharma, knowledge and non-violence:
"स्वाधीनैव समृद्धिर्जनोपजीव्यत्वमुच्छ्रयश्छाया।
सत्पुंसो मरुभूरिव जीवनमात्रं समाशास्यम्॥"
It conveys the message that dharma leads to the highest good, forgiveness brings the highest peace, knowledge gives the highest fulfilment, and non-violence is the source of true happiness.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
एको धर्मः परं श्रेयः क्षमैका शान्तिरुत्तमा।
विद्यैका परमा तृप्तिरहिंसैका सुखावहा॥
एको धर्मः परं श्रेयः क्षमैका शान्तिरुत्तमा। विद्यैका परमा तृप्तिरहिंसैका सुखावहा॥ pic.twitter.com/OPxUBuq67h — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 21, 2026
